Overview

For adults over 50 who want to remain active, strong, independent, and performing at a high level, daily micronutrition becomes even more important because the body naturally becomes less efficient at absorbing and utilizing key nutrients with age. Over50MV was specifically designed to help fill those nutritional gaps with the vitamins, minerals, and supportive nutrients most older adults commonly fall short on — including highly absorbable forms of B12, magnesium, vitamins D, K1, and K2, plus choline for brain, muscle, and liver health. Unlike generic store brands, this formula was built specifically for active adults over 50 to support energy production, bone strength, cardiovascular health, cognitive function, recovery, and long-term vitality so they can continue training, working, traveling, playing with family, and enjoying the lifestyle they’ve worked hard to maintain. It’s not about “getting older” — it’s about continuing to perform, recover, and live actively for decades to come.

“Over50MV™ — Stay Strong. Stay Sharp. Stay Active.”

What is it?

Over50MV is dotFIT's daily multivitamin and mineral formula designed specifically for adults over 50. It delivers the essential vitamins and minerals your body still needs as you age — without iron, which research shows can be problematic for some older adults — plus higher amounts of B12, choline, and other nutrients that become harder to absorb or more important as you get older.

What does it do?

Over50MV fills the everyday nutrition gaps that food alone often can't cover. It provides all the known potentially under-consumed vitamins and minerals at corrective doses, designed to bring your daily intake up to recommended levels. Vitamin D and magnesium support bone health, energy, and sleep. Both forms of vitamin K — K1 and K2 — support cardiovascular health and direct calcium where it belongs. Two forms of B12, including methylcobalamin, support brain health and neurological function. Choline, often missing from typical multivitamins, supports brain, liver, and muscle health. And the carefully balanced antioxidants help your body manage the daily oxidative stress of aging. It's everyday foundational support for staying strong, sharp, and active.

Who is it for?

Over50MV is for adults 50 and older who want to maintain energy, brain function, bone health, and overall vitality as they age. Active adults who've graduated from the demands of their younger years but still want comprehensive daily nutrition. Anyone whose diet doesn't consistently include all the food groups that supply these essential nutrients. If you train hard and intensely, you may want to stay on ActiveMV through your mid-60s before transitioning. Otherwise, Over50MV is the right daily foundation from 50 onward.

How do you use it?

Simple. Take two tablets daily with your favorite beverage after your first meal of the day. Taking it with food helps with absorption and is gentler on your stomach. Splitting your 2 tabs, 1 with an AM meal and 1 with a PM meal, allows for greater daily utilization. Pair it with a complete diet, and add other dotFIT products like CalciumComplex or Antioxidants if your specific needs call for it.

What makes it different?

Ours isn't a generic, store-bought senior multivitamin. Many products in this category either keep iron in — which can be a problem for older adults with unknown cardiovascular concerns — or skip the cofactors that make the rest of the formula work. We don't take that approach. Over50MV uses both forms of vitamin K and both forms of B12, including methylcobalamin, the form most effective for brain support. It includes choline, an essential nutrient over 90 percent of Americans fall short on. Magnesium is delivered as magnesium citrate for better absorption. Iron is intentionally left out so you can supplement separately only if a blood test confirms you need it. And it's 3rd party tested and manufactured to pharmaceutical standards exclusively for dotFIT. Every ingredient, every form, every dose is chosen for adults over 50 — not just rebadged from a younger formula.

Overview

Most people don’t realize that Vitamin D isn’t just about bones—it’s about your whole body. In fact, it’s more like a hormone than a vitamin, controlling over 2,000 genes that affect your heart, muscles, brain, and immune system. The problem is, almost no one gets enough from food or safe sun exposure. That’s why supplementation is critical. Taking a daily dose of Vitamin D3 helps keep your levels in the optimal range, which has been shown to reduce risk of fractures, boost strength and recovery, support immunity, and contribute to overall healthy aging. For most people, a minimum of 1,000 to 2,000 IU per day is needed, but some may require more depending on lifestyle and health status. The bottom line—if you’re serious about health, performance, or longevity, Vitamin D3 is one of the simplest and most powerful daily habits you can start right now. And always pair with your daily MVM since all vitamins work synergistically, especially vitamin D with Vitamins K1 & K2.

What is it?

This product is a professional-grade Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) supplement designed to safely and effectively raise and maintain optimal serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] levels. Unlike Vitamin D2, Vitamin D3 is more potent, has a longer half-life, and is better at sustaining healthy blood concentrations. It is intended to augment the vitamin D obtained from food, fortified sources, multivitamins, and sunlight exposure, ensuring users consistently achieve levels that promote not only bone health but also overall vitality, performance, and longevity. NSF Certified for Sport.

What does it do?

Vitamin D plays a role in nearly every system in your body. It supports bone strength, muscle function, immune health, mood, and athletic performance. The science is clear that maintaining healthy vitamin D levels — above 30 nanograms per milliliter — is associated with better long-term health outcomes. For athletes, levels above 40 are associated with better performance. The challenge is that most people can't reach those updated levels through diet, sunlight or even through a multivitamin and mineral formula alone. dotFIT Vitamin D3 helps close that gap consistently and safely.

Who is it for?

Vitamin D3 is for almost everyone. Vitamin D insufficiency and deficiency are widespread due to limited sun exposure, indoor lifestyles, darker skin pigmentation, aging, and modern diets low in fatty fish or fortified foods. Moreover, older adults' bodies make less vitamin D from sunlight. In people with darker skin, melanin blocks the UVB rays that produce vitamin D. In people with higher body fat, vitamin D gets stored in fat tissue and becomes less available. Anyone who works indoors, lives in northern climates, or wears sunscreen regularly is a candidate for vitamin D supplementation. And almost all athletes who want to maximize performance and recovery.

How do you use it?

Simple. Take it daily with a meal containing some fat — vitamin D is fat-soluble, so it absorbs best that way. Use it alongside your daily multivitamin and other vitamin D sources to reach your target level. The label includes progressive dosing recommendations to help you find the right amount for your needs.

What makes it different?

Ours isn't a generic, store-bought vitamin D pill that is sold in a vacuum. The dotFIT Vitamin D3 is formulated and calibrated to work synergistically with the rest of the dotFIT lineup — so when combined with our multivitamins or other products, you stay in the safe and effective range. No megadoses, no guesswork, no unnecessary fillers. NSF Certified for Sport, third-party tested for purity, potency, and banned substances. And manufactured to pharmaceutical standards exclusively for dotFIT. Simple, clean, evidence-based — exactly what a daily vitamin D supplement should be.

Overview

For women ages 18–50 who want to stay healthy, energized, active, and performing at their best, daily micronutrition is foundational because even a good diet often falls short in delivering the essential nutrients needed to support energy production, recovery, immune health, bone strength, skin, hair and nails, hormonal health, and long-term wellness. Women’sMV was specifically designed to provide the key nutrients women in this stage of life commonly under-consume — including iron for healthy blood and energy, folate and choline for reproductive and brain health, highly absorbable forms of B12 for mental focus and energy metabolism, plus vitamins D and K to support bone and cardiovascular health. Unlike generic store brands, every ingredient, form, and dose was selected specifically for active women and manufactured to pharmaceutical standards with third-party testing for safety and accuracy. Whether the goal is exercise performance, maintaining a healthy body composition, supporting future health, or simply keeping up with the demands of life, Women’sMV helps provide the nutritional foundation needed to feel strong, resilient, and consistently perform at a higher level every day.

“Women’sMV™ — Daily Nutrition for Strength, Energy & Lifelong Vitality.”

What is it?

Women'sMV is dotFIT's daily multivitamin and mineral formula designed specifically for women ages 18 to 50. Most importantly it delivers the 20 known potentially under-consumed essential vitamins and minerals at corrective doses, formulated with the nutrients women in this life stage need most — including iron, folate, B12, choline, and vitamins A and D — in the right forms and amounts to complement a typical diet.

What does it do?

Women'sMV fills the everyday nutrition gaps that food alone often can't cover. It supports energy, immune function, bone strength, skin, hair and nails, brain health, and overall vitality. Iron is included at the higher levels women need to support healthy blood and energy, especially during menstruation. Folate and choline support reproductive health and are critical during early pregnancy — often before pregnancy is even known. Both forms of vitamin K and both forms of B12 — including methylcobalamin — support bone, heart, and brain health. Vitamin D is dosed higher than most multivitamins, in line with the levels research now associates with better long-term health. And the formula is built to work synergistically with the rest of the dotFIT lineup, so adding products like Calcium Complex or Omega3 keeps everything in the safe and effective range.

Who is it for?

Women'sMV is for women ages 18 to 50 who want a daily nutritional foundation. Women whose diets don't always include the variety of food groups needed to meet recommended levels. Women planning a pregnancy or who could become pregnant — since folate, choline, and iron matter most before pregnancy is even confirmed. Recreationally active women who train a few times a week and want to support recovery and energy. If you're a highly competitive athlete training intensely most days, dotFIT recommends staying on two ActiveMV daily until age 50. Otherwise, Women'sMV is the right daily foundation.

How do you use it?

Simple. Take one tablet daily with your favorite beverage immediately after your first food meal of the day. Taking it with food helps absorption and is gentler on the stomach. Pair it with a complete diet, and add other dotFIT products like Calcium Complex, Omega3, or Antioxidants if your specific goals call for it.

What makes it different?

Ours isn't a generic, store-bought women's multivitamin. Most multivitamins for women are either underdosed across the board or use cheaper forms of key nutrients. We don't take that approach. Women'sMV uses both forms of vitamin B12, including methylcobalamin for brain support. Both forms of vitamin K. Magnesium in citrate and oxide for better absorption. Choline — an essential nutrient over 90 percent of Americans fall short on, and one rarely included in multivitamins. Vitamin A in both preformed and beta-carotene forms, since women metabolize these differently. And iron at the level women actually need, not the lower amount used in unisex formulas. Manufactured to pharmaceutical standards exclusively for dotFIT and 3rd party tested. Every ingredient, every form, every dose — chosen specifically for women in this life stage.

LeanMeal is scientifically formulated with the macronutrient ratio research actually shows works for weight management — high protein, moderate low-glycemic carbs, fiber, low fat, no sugar. And it's manufactured to pharmaceutical standards exclusively for dotFIT and 3rd party tested for purity, potency and delivery. A clean, calorie-controlled, scientifically-balanced meal — that actually helps you reach your goals.

Overview

DigestiveEnzymes is a five-enzyme complex that supports your body's own digestion — helping break down the protein, carbs, fats, dairy sugar, and fiber in your meals. Natural enzyme production can dip with age, diet changes, and lifestyle, and when it does, food doesn't break down as cleanly — which can mean bloating, gas, or the sense you're not getting everything out of what you eat. Taken with meals, it tops up what your body already makes, to support smoother digestion and better nutrient absorption. DigestiveEnzymes — help your body get more from every meal.

What is it?

DigestiveEnzymes is a capsule that delivers DigeZyme®, a five-enzyme blend from Sabinsa: neutral protease for protein, α-amylase for carbohydrates, lipase for fats, lactase for the sugar in dairy, and cellulase for fiber. The enzymes are microbe-derived through fermentation, which makes them vegan-friendly, gluten-free, and unusually stable — they keep working across the wide range of acidity in your digestive tract. They're made to Food Chemicals Codex standards and third-party tested. You take one with each main meal.

What does it do?

Your body makes enzymes to break food down into the nutrients it can actually absorb — amino acids, vitamins, minerals, glucose, fats. But natural production can fall short with age, stress, medications, or foods your system isn't used to, and under-digested food can leave you with minor bloating, gas, or cramping. DigestiveEnzymes adds to your own supply across all the major food groups — including the dairy sugar lactose and the fiber your body can't break down on its own — to support more comfortable digestion and help you get more out of what you eat. There's also some evidence the protease may help ease exercise-induced muscle soreness.

Who is it for?

It's for anyone dealing with occasional, minor digestive discomfort — bloating, gas, or cramping after meals — or who finds certain foods, like dairy, harder to digest than they used to. Because natural enzyme output tends to decline with age, it can be especially useful for older adults and for anyone whose diet or routine has recently changed. Exercisers may notice a recovery bonus from the protease. It isn't for use during pregnancy or nursing, and if you take blood thinners or certain antibiotics, check with your doctor first.

How do you use it?

Take three capsules a day — one with each of your three main meals — so the enzymes are present when food arrives and digestion is underway. They're built to stay active throughout your digestive tract, so taking them with food is the thing that matters. One honest note: if you're using it purely for digestive comfort and don't notice a difference after about 30 days of consistent use, there may be no reason to keep taking it for that particular goal.

What makes it different?

Many enzyme products give you the basic three — protease, amylase, and lipase. DigestiveEnzymes adds two more: lactase, for the sugar in dairy, and cellulase, for the fiber your body can't break down on its own — so it covers more of what you actually eat. The enzymes are microbe-derived, which means they work at lower doses and stay active across the full pH range of your gut, where many animal-based enzymes can't. They're vegan-friendly, gluten-free, made to Food Chemicals Codex standards, third-party tested, and formulated to fit alongside the rest of your dotFIT regimen.

Overview

Probiotics delivers 35 billion live cultures from eight strains of the two most-studied beneficial bacteria — Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium — plus a prebiotic blend to feed them. Diet, stress, aging, and antibiotics can throw your gut's bacterial balance off, and since so much of your digestion and immune defense lives in the gut, that balance matters. Taken daily, it helps restore and maintain the good bacteria that keep your gut — and the rest of you — running well. Probiotics — restore the balance your gut depends on.

What is it?

Probiotics is a once-daily capsule with 35 billion CFUs from eight strains of Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium, the two most-researched families of beneficial gut bacteria. It also includes a prebiotic blend — fiber that feeds those bacteria — making it a complete pro- and prebiotic formula in one. The strains are specially acid-resistant, so they survive stomach acid and reach the gut alive, and they're shelf-stable without refrigeration. It's third-party tested for guaranteed potency through the expiration date printed on the bottle.

What does it do?

Your gut is home to trillions of bacteria, and keeping the beneficial ones dominant is central to your health: they help you digest food and absorb nutrients, crowd out harmful bacteria, and support your immune system — much of which lives in the gut lining. Everyday factors like diet, stress, aging, and antibiotics can tip that balance the wrong way. Taken before carb-containing meals, it can ease the calorie math of dieting while you keep up sensible eating and regular exercise. No stimulants, no jitters, no effect on your nervous system. CarbRepel — let the carbs you love work a little less against you.

What is it?

CarbRepel is a non-stimulant weight-management supplement built around Phase 2®, a clinically studied extract of the white kidney bean (Phaseolus vulgaris). Phase 2® is an alpha-amylase inhibitor — it interferes with the enzyme that breaks starch down for absorption. It's rounded out with citrus pectin, a fruit fiber, and pomegranate leaf extract. You take it shortly before your largest starch-containing meals. It's third-party tested and made to GMP standards in an NSF-certified facility.

What does it do?

When you eat starchy carbohydrates, an enzyme called alpha-amylase breaks them down so your body can absorb them. Phase 2® partially blocks that enzyme, so some of that starch passes through undigested instead of being absorbed as calories. The FDA has accepted two claims for the ingredient: that it may reduce the enzymatic digestion of dietary starches, and that it may assist in weight control when used alongside a sensible diet and exercise program. The Citrus Pectin (CP) is a natural fiber found in many fruits and used in this product to help in the delivery of the active ingredient Phaseolus vulgaris (Phase 2).

Who is it for?

It's for people actively working toward fat loss who tend to crave or overeat carbohydrates and want help blunting the impact of starchy meals. But also for anyone consuming carbohydrates as part of their diet to allow the carb intake but reduce the calories. Because it's non-stimulant, it suits anyone who wants a fat-loss aid without caffeine or any effect on the central nervous system. It can also be used occasionally — on a day when carb intake runs high — to help keep weight steady, or as part of a structured plan like LeanPak90. It isn't for use during pregnancy or nursing.

How do you use it?

Take two tablets, twice daily, about 30 minutes before your two largest carbohydrate-containing meals, with at least 8 ounces of fluid. Timing matters: it works on the starch in the meal you're about to eat, so take it before, not after. Use it while you're actively pursuing your goal, then taper off once your eating habits and lifestyle hold the result on their own. If you take diabetes medication, monitor your blood sugar closely and check with your doctor, since the ingredient can affect glucose response.

What makes it different?

CarbRepel is built on Phase 2®, one of the most-studied carbohydrate-control ingredients available, with FDA-accepted structure/function claims behind it. Just as important is what it isn't: it's completely non-stimulant, so there's no caffeine, no jitters, and no effect on your nervous system — a real contrast to the many fat-loss products that simply load up on stimulants. It's positioned honestly as a tool that works with a sensible diet and exercise, not a substitute for them. Third-party tested and made to GMP standards in an NSF-certified facility.

Creatine fuels the energy system your body relies on for short, explosive efforts — sprinting, lifting, jumping, anything that demands quick power. By saturating your muscles with creatine, it helps you push harder during training, recover faster between sets, and build more lean muscle over time. Newer research also shows benefits beyond performance — including support for brain function, healthy aging, and bone and muscle preservation as you get older.
